title: HIV-1 NC-POL Amplification and Oxford Nanopore Sequencing for Drug Resistance Analysis
author: Nicola Coetzee
materials: Translated NC consensus sequence mutation analysis: Geneious Prime.

steps.title: Extract viral RNA from plasma
steps.instruction: Add 0.5–1 mL plasma to a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube, add 600 µL Viral Lysis Buffer, mix gently, then add 600 µL 100 % Isopropanol and invert 30 times. Incubate at room temperature for 10 min, vortex briefly (do not vortex vigorously) and spin down. Centrifuge at 21 100 × g, 10 °C for 20 min, discard supernatant with a fine‑tip Pasteur pipette, add 1000 µL 70 % EtOH and centrifuge at 21 100 × g, 10 °C for 20 min (first two washes) and 10 min (final wash). Centrifuge at 21 100 × g, 10 °C for 20 min. Add 600 µL 100 % Isopropanol, mix by inversion 30 times, incubate at room temperature for 10 min, vortex briefly, spin down, then centrifuge at 24 000 × g, 10 °C for 1 h. Transfer supernatant to a new tube, centrifuge at 2 700 × g, 4 °C for 15 min. Discard supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend RNA pellet in Tris‑HCl
steps.instruction: Resuspend the RNA pellet in ice‑cold 5 mM Tris‑HCl using the volume based on plasma viral load: 20 µL for ≤20 000 copies/mL, 35 µL for 50 000–100 000 copies/mL, 50 µL for >100 000 copies/mL (if viral load unknown, use 20 µL). Briefly centrifuge and remove any residual EtOH with a P10 pipette.

steps.title: Prepare RNA‑primer mix
steps.instruction: For each reaction combine: 0.5 µL 10 mM dNTPs (final 0.5 mM), 0.25 µL 10 µM reverse primer set R1a:R1b (final 0.25 µM), nuclease‑free water to bring volume to 1 µL, and 10 µL template RNA. Total volume = 13 µL per reaction.

steps.title: Prepare reverse transcription mix
steps.instruction: For each reaction combine: 4 µL 5× SSIV buffer (final 1×), 1 µL 0.1 M DTT (final 0.01 M), 1 µL RNase inhibitor (40 U), 1 µL SuperScript IV RT (50 U). Total volume = 7 µL per reaction.

steps.title: Combine RNA with primer mix and denature
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL RNA to the RNA‑primer mix, mix, then incubate at 65 °C for 5 min and immediately place on ice for at least 2 min.

steps.title: Perform reverse transcription
steps.instruction: Add 7 µL RT mix to the cooled RNA‑primer mixture, mix gently, incubate at 50 °C for 50 min, then at 85 °C for 5 min.

steps.title: Purify cDNA with RNAClean XP beads
steps.instruction: Transfer 20 µL cDNA to a 1.5 mL tube. Add 36 µL RNAClean XP beads (1.8× cDNA volume), pipette mix until beads are resuspended, and incubate at room temperature for 10 min. Place tubes on a magnetic rack for ~5 min until liquid clears, then discard supernatant. Wash beads 3× with 250 µL 70 % EtOH, briefly centrifuge and remove any remaining EtOH with a P10 pipette without disturbing the bead pellet. Resuspend beads in 20 µL 5 mM Tris‑HCl, briefly centrifuge and incubate on a shaker at room temperature for 5 min. Place on magnetic rack for ~2 min, then transfer the eluate to a new microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Prepare pre‑nested PCR master mix
steps.instruction: For each reaction combine: 10 µL 2× SuperFi II PCR Master Mix (final 1×), 0.4 µL 20 µM forward primer set F1a:F1b (final 0.4 µM), 0.4 µL 20 µM reverse primer set R1a:R1b (final 0.4 µM), 4.2 µL nuclease‑free water, and later add 5 µL purified cDNA (adjusted: undiluted if plasma viral load <50 000 copies/mL, 1:20 dilution if ≥50 000 copies/mL). Total volume = 20 µL per reaction.

steps.title: Set up pre‑nested PCR reactions
steps.instruction: Aliquot 15 µL of the pre‑nested master mix into each PCR tube, add 3 µL antisense mix, then add 5 µL purified cDNA (adjusted as described). Seal tubes, briefly spin down.

steps.title: Run pre‑nested PCR thermocycling
steps.instruction: Program the thermocycler as follows: Phase I – 98 °C 2 min (1 cycle); Phase II – 98 °C 10 s, 58 °C 15 s, 72 °C 3 min (5 cycles); Phase III (touchdown) – 98 °C 10 s, anneal starting at 58 °C decreasing 0.5 °C each cycle for 15 cycles (15 s), 72 °C 3 min (15 cycles); Phase IV – 98 °C 10 s, 50 °C 15 s, 72 °C 3 min (15 cycles); Phase V – 72 °C 6 min final extension.

steps.title: Dilute pre‑nested PCR product
steps.instruction: Dilute the pre‑nested PCR product 1:50 with 5 mM Tris‑HCl.

steps.title: Prepare nested PCR master mix
steps.instruction: For each reaction combine: 10 µL 2× SuperFi II PCR Master Mix (final 1×), 0.4 µL 20 µM forward primer set (final 0.4 µM), 0.4 µL 20 µM reverse primer set (final 0.4 µM), 4.2 µL nuclease‑free water. Total volume = 15 µL per reaction (master mix).

steps.title: Set up nested PCR reactions
steps.instruction: Aliquot 15 µL of the nested master mix into each PCR tube, add 5 µL of the 1:50 diluted pre‑nested product, seal and spin down.

steps.title: Run nested PCR thermocycling
steps.instruction: Run the same thermocycling program as for the pre‑nested PCR (see Step 9). After amplification, verify product size (~3.5 kb) by agarose gel electrophoresis.

steps.title: Purify nested PCR product with AMPure XP beads
steps.instruction: Transfer 16 µL nested PCR product to a DNA LoBind tube, incubate on a shaking incubator at 900 rpm, room temperature for 5 min. Add 28.8 µL AMPure XP beads (1.8× reaction volume), pipette mix until beads are resuspended, incubate at room temperature for >5 min, place on magnetic rack for ~2 min, discard supernatant. Wash beads 2× with 250 µL 80 % EtOH, briefly centrifuge and remove remaining EtOH with a P10 pipette. Resuspend beads in 20 µL 5 mM Tris‑HCl, briefly centrifuge and incubate on a shaking incubator at 900 rpm, 37 °C for 5 min. Place on magnetic rack for ~2 min, discard supernatant, and transfer eluate to a new DNA LoBind tube.

steps.title: Quantify DNA and prepare sequencing input
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration using the Qubit dsDNA HS Assay on a Qubit fluorometer. Prepare 200 fmol (≈455 ng for a 3.5 kb amplicon) per sample for sequencing; use concentrations to pool samples equimolarly.

steps.title: Prepare ONT library using Native Barcoding Kit
steps.instruction: Follow the Oxford Nanopore Technologies Native Barcoding Kit 96 V14 (SQK‑NBD114.96) protocol to generate sequencing libraries, ensuring no more than 30 amplicons per Flongle.

steps.title: Load library onto ONT flow cell and run
steps.instruction: Load the library onto an R10.4.1 Flongle (FLO‑FLG114) or R10.4.1 flow cell (FLO‑MIN114) and run on a GridION. Use standard run time of 24 h, high‑accuracy basecalling, barcode trimming, size selection for reads 2.5–4.5 kb, and a minimum Q‑score of 9.

steps.title: Analyze sequencing data and interpret drug resistance
steps.instruction: Process the data with Nano‑RECall for the POL region and Nano_RECall_NC for the Gag‑NC region, aiming for ≥400× coverage across both regions. Interpret drug resistance mutations using the Stanford University HIV Drug Resistance Database.
